profile.campus: True North Data campus, Loudoun County, VA (Loudoun County zoning case ZMAP-2017-0003, PIN 194103673000, approved Jan 2018)
profile.reading: This building sits at 42311 Thunderball Drive in Leesburg, Virginia, part of a data center campus that Loudoun County own zoning and permitting records identify by the project name True North Data. Loudoun County zoning case ZMAP-2017-0003, filed under that project name, rezoned roughly 105 acres to Planned Development-Office Park specifically to allow data center uses, and was approved January 18, 2018. The underlying parcel, county PIN 194103673000, covering roughly 97 acres, is recorded under a condominium-regime plat named True North Land Condo, a legal structure commonly used to subdivide one large hyperscale campus parcel into separately titled buildings, consistent with the six separate addresses and building records that make up this cluster. A 2019 grading permit for a project called True North 2 described three data center buildings with utilities, and a 2023 stormwater permit for True North Data Phase 2A covered a further 16.5 acres of disturbed area, indicating a phased expansion. Four tenant fit-up zoning permits were issued across April and May 2025, suggesting the campus was still being built out in phases as recently as that year. No document reviewed this session, however, gives a total megawatt capacity, final building count, or total square footage for the completed campus, and the identity of the corporate entity that actually filed the original 2017 rezoning application is not exposed in the county public zoning-case layer, so True North Data Solutions, the name this record carries as operator, could not be independently confirmed as a registered company through the Virginia State Corporation Commission this session. Loudoun County is widely described as the largest data center market in the world by capacity, and Leesburg location within it, near the eastern edge of the county fiber and power-dense corridor, is consistent with why a developer would pursue a multi-building campus of this scale here specifically.
profile.research_note: True North Data project, ZMAP-2017-0003 (approved Jan 2018), PIN 194103673000/True North Land Condo plat, 2019 grading permit for 3 buildings, 2023 Phase 2A stormwater permit, 2025 tenant fit-up permits, all confirmed via Loudoun County own GIS/permit records. No MW, total sqft, or investment figure found in any accessible county record. True North Data Solutions as a specific corporate/legal entity name could not be verified via VA SCC this session (interactive-only portal). See companion way/1387391201 (TikTok Data Center) for the unconfirmed tenant-name finding on this same campus.

reading.body:
Most Virginia data centers do not publish power consumption, making it impossible to assess this facility's role in the state's AI infrastructure or grid capacity.

This Leesburg campus in Loudoun County belongs to True North Data Solutions, which operates six mapped properties in the immediate area. No corporate website is currently reachable, and independent sources contain no information about this specific building. The facility's megawatts, square footage, and even complete address details remain unpublished.

Virginia has 326 mapped data center facilities, but only 23 disclose power figures, totaling 1,375 megawatts. This opacity is the norm rather than the exception. Without published capacity data, this campus cannot be ranked against other state facilities or assessed for its contribution to compute concentration in Northern Virginia, a region of significant AI infrastructure development.

The absence of sourcing limits what can be inferred. This building may be operational, dormant, or abandoned. It cannot be evaluated for grid stress, power availability, or its impact on AI scaling constraints in the state without either operator disclosure or independent confirmation.
